8 Places to Visit in Patna

TAP TO EXPLORE ALL 8 PLACES↗
01Patna Zoo
Nature • Family • Wildlife

Patna Zoo

Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park is a 153-acre green escape on Bailey Road, combining wildlife, gardens, trails and a lake.

  • 153 acres of green space
  • Home to 800+ animals and diverse flora
  • Lake, boating, toy train and nature trails
Official Patna Zoo ↗
02Bihar Museum
History • Art • Culture

Bihar Museum

A modern cultural landmark on Bailey Road where Bihar's history, art and heritage meet contemporary museum design.

  • Immersive galleries & modern architecture
  • Ancient art, archaeology and cultural objects
  • A strong family-friendly learning experience
Official Bihar Museum ↗
03Mahavir Mandir
Spiritual • Heritage

Mahavir Mandir

One of Patna's most recognisable Hanuman temples, right beside the Patna Junction area and deeply woven into city life.

  • Dedicated to Lord Hanuman
  • Especially vibrant during Ram Navami
  • Famous for its Naivedyam offering
Official Mahavir Mandir ↗
04JP Ganga Path
Riverfront • Sunset • City Life

Patna Marine Drive

Commonly called Patna Marine Drive, the J.P. Ganga Path is a 20.5-km four-lane corridor along the southern bank of the Ganga, from Digha to Deedarganj.

  • Official name: Loknayak Ganga Path
  • Runs along the Ganga
  • 20.5 km Digha–Deedarganj corridor
Official JP Ganga Path project info ↗
05Gandhi Sangrahalaya
History • Gandhi • Museum

Gandhi Sangrahalaya

A quiet museum near Gandhi Maidan that preserves stories, photographs and material connected to Gandhi and his role in Bihar.

  • Established in 1967
  • Photographs, books and archival material
  • Focus on Gandhi's life and Bihar's freedom movement
Official Gandhi Sangrahalaya ↗
06Bapu Tower
Architecture • History • Experience

Bapu Tower

A striking Gardanibagh landmark built as an immersive tribute to Mahatma Gandhi and Bihar's connection with his life and ideas.

  • 120 feet tall, six-storey landmark
  • Immersive galleries & turntable theatre
  • Distinctive copper-clad architecture
Official Bapu Tower ↗
07Patna Sahib
Sikh Heritage • Spiritual

Patna Sahib

Takht Sri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib is one of Sikhism's five Takhts and a major pilgrimage landmark in Patna City.

  • One of the five Takhts of Sikhism
  • Birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji
  • Major heritage site in Patna City
Official Patna Sahib ↗
08Buddha Smriti Park
Peace • Meditation • Heritage

Buddha Smriti Park

A 22-acre urban oasis near Patna Junction, centred around the striking Pataliputra Karuna Stupa.

  • 22 acres of landscaped park
  • 200-ft Pataliputra Karuna Stupa
  • Relics, meditation centre, museum and library
Patna District ↗

20 Famous Celebrities from Patna, Bihar

CLICK TO SEE ALL 20 CELEBRITIES↗
01
Bollywood • Actor

Sushant Singh Rajput

Actor born in Patna, remembered for Kai Po Che!, MS Dhoni: The Untold Story and Chhichhore. He moved from television into Hindi cinema and became known for performances that combined emotional depth with a natural screen presence. He also had a strong interest in science, astronomy and technology.

02
Bollywood • Actress

Sonakshi Sinha

Actress born in Patna, known for Dabangg, Lootera and several Hindi films. She made her Bollywood debut with Dabangg and quickly became one of the industry's recognisable leading actresses. She has since explored action, comedy and more performance-driven roles.

03
Bollywood • Actor & Politician

Shatrughan Sinha

Born in Patna, the veteran actor is known for films including Kalicharan and Dostana. He became famous for his distinctive voice, dialogue delivery and charismatic screen presence. After a successful film career, he entered politics and became a prominent public figure.

04
Entertainment • Actor & Host

Shekhar Suman

Born in Patna, he is known for acting, television hosting and Movers & Shakers. He has worked across films, television and live entertainment for decades. His television work, especially his sharp interview and comedy style, made him a household name.

05

Nitu Chandra

Actress born in Patna, also known for production and sports entrepreneurship. Alongside acting, she has worked as a producer and has been involved with projects in Hindi and regional cinema. She has also represented India in sports and has a strong connection with Bihar's cultural scene.

Art • Contemporary Artist

Subodh Gupta

Internationally recognised contemporary artist, listed in the Patna people and visual-arts community. His installations often transform ordinary Indian household objects into striking contemporary artworks. His work has been displayed in major galleries and exhibitions in India and abroad.

17
Cricket • Wicketkeeper-Batter

Ishan Kishan

Cricketer born in Patna who has represented India in international cricket. He has represented India internationally and has been a prominent performer in domestic cricket and the IPL. His attacking batting and fearless approach make him an exciting wicketkeeper-batter.

18
Cricket • Former India Player

Saba Karim

Former Indian wicketkeeper-batter and cricket administrator, born in Patna. He represented India as a wicketkeeper-batter and later contributed to cricket through administration and analysis. His experience gives him a distinctive perspective on Indian cricket.

19
Public Life • Lawyer & Politician

Ravi Shankar Prasad

Lawyer and politician born in Patna who has served as a Union minister. He has served in several important Union government roles, including law and information technology. He is also a senior advocate and has been active in public life for many years.

20
Business • Industrialist

Anil Agarwal

Industrialist born in Patna and founder of Vedanta Resources. He built Vedanta into a major natural-resources business with interests in metals, mining and energy. His journey is often cited as an example of Indian entrepreneurship and business expansion.
